name: abmcp
description: Full official Blender Lab MCP server (all 26 tools via abmcp_mcp + blender_mcp_addon) combined with Spec-driven autonomous 3D CAD, architectural, and hard-surface modeling in Blender. Features Building Spec JSON anchoring, rotated plan leveling & metric calibration, section slab elevation fitting, bmesh floor-cut IoU verification, native RANDOM shading, structural profiles, and N-panel bridge APIs.
suggestedPrompts: 根据输入的平立剖面与实景图，先用官方 MCP 工具与 plan_prep/section_levels 定标锁定 Building Spec，再按 L1/L2/L3 在 Blender 完成高精度三维建模并通过水平剖切验收
对斜置建筑平面图扫描纠偏并建立局部正交网格，识别内天井、悬挑与错层轮廓后生成多视图、节点特写与楼层剖切叠加图
利用官方 MCP 场景摘要、文档检索与原生 RANDOM 分色审校当前 Blender 场景的拓扑、细部台账与各层 z+cut 剖切 IoU，修复偏差后执行 finish_materials 与 Site_Yaw 交付
